g.text: Credit data and decisioning environment — Processes and Capabilities
One system, every process that uses it and in what role, and the capabilities those processes support. This shows the business impact of changing the system. A
long list against a low criticality rating is worth a second look.

g.title: Set and deploy credit decision strategy
Perform account review and reissue decision
Acquire and refresh credit bureau data
Construct and approve firm offer of credit
Review campaign performance and adjust targeting
